proof_scope: Tau ops-discord notification idempotency for repair categories

claims.proves: Tau detects an already-notified repair category before external notification execution, writes a DEDUPED notification receipt, preserves the source receipt, and emits a fail-closed adjudication routing manifest.
claims.does_not_prove: Discord network delivery or human adjudication.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Repeated human-adjudication routing for the same repair category does not create duplicate external notifications.
